items.q: What age group is Ikigyan suitable for?
items.a: Ikigyan is designed for primary and middle-school children, with content and language calibrated by age band across every book, puzzle and session.

items.q: How does the 26-week school programme work?
items.a: Schools begin with two free demo classes, then move into a structured 26-week curriculum of weekly curiosity sessions, activities and puzzles built around real-world knowledge.

items.q: What happens during the 2 free demo classes?
items.a: Children experience an actual Ikigyan session — a live curiosity question, guided thinking and a puzzle — so schools can see the method in action before committing.

items.q: How can a school partner with Ikigyan?
items.a: Reach out through our School Partnership Enquiry form. Our team will schedule the demo classes and walk you through onboarding.

items.q: How can I order a book?
items.a: Books like Educonomy can be ordered directly on our site or via WhatsApp — see the Books page for details.

items.q: Do you offer bulk orders for classrooms or libraries?
items.a: Yes — schools and institutions can request bulk pricing for classroom sets, libraries and events.

items.q: Is my child's data safe with Ikigyan?
items.a: There are no child accounts and we collect minimal data. Read our Privacy Policy for full details on what we do and don't collect.

items.q: How can I contact Ikigyan for help?
items.a: Email us any time — our team typically responds within one working day.
